incident-bot: PAGING P0: decode-stream pool (rg-decode-us-east-3) reporting repeated GPU OOMs, containers restarting, and ~35% request failures in last 4m. On-call alerted.
SRE-Oncall (nora): I'm taking lead. Pulling container logs and GPU metrics. @eng-runtime please ack.
eng-runtime (bob): ack. Seeing patterns: requests with no max_tokens header and very large prompt prefixes. Kernel logs show cudaErrorIllegalAddress during allocation growth. Probable runaway generation.
SRE-Oncall (nora): quick log sample: ```
[2026-03-17T12:04:12Z] stream(start) id=stream-9abc prompt_tokens=512
[2026-03-17T12:04:13Z] http: header max_tokens missing, treating as unlimited
[2026-03-17T12:04:16Z] decode: token_count est=0 -> 60000 allocation failed: cudaErrorIllegalAddress
[2026-03-17T12:04:16Z] container: exit status 137, restarting
```
eng-runtime (bob): Runtime default behavior is legacy: missing max_tokens => unlimited. That allowed clients to trigger huge expansions.
Alice-CustOps: Impacted customers: cust-alpha and cust-gamma (high throughput). CS notified and preparing interim messaging.
SRE-Oncall (nora): Immediate mitigations proposed: 1) edge-level reject for requests lacking max_tokens (400) 2) ingress default max_tokens enforced (service-default=512) 3) restart decode pool pods with DECODE_PREFETCH=0 and NV_JIT_KERNEL_FALLBACK=1 to lower memory peak 4) move affected tenants to dedicated pool.
devex (alice): I can push the edge rule to reject missing header with a short error body and link to docs. Rolling as a fast change now (30s rollout).
ops (javier): Starting migration for cust-alpha to dedicated-decoder-us-east-1. Estimated 9m. Creating migration ticket and load balancer routing.
eng-runtime (bob): Patching runtime now to interpret absent max_tokens as configured default instead of unbounded. Hotpatch to canary pods applied. Patch snippet: ```diff
- if (!hdr.has_max_tokens()) tokens_allowed = UNBOUNDED;
+ if (!hdr.has_max_tokens()) tokens_allowed = config.api.default_max_tokens;
```
SRE-Oncall (nora): Edge reject is live: we are blocking ~1200 rps with missing header. Observed decode pool error rate dropping on canary path.
eng-runtime (bob): Canary pods stable, memory and GPU alloc patterns normalized. Rolling patch to remaining pods with graceful drain. Also enabling token-count precheck to abort allocations estimated over 10k tokens.
SRE-Oncall (nora): After restarts with env tweaks, kernel errors subsided and containers stopped restarting. Request failure rate reduced to ~4%.
Alice-CustOps: cust-gamma is patching their client to add max_tokens. CS will check in every 15m and escalate if needed.
eng-runtime (bob): Follow-ups for post-incident: 1) make default max_tokens explicit in API spec and SDKs, 2) add lint/CI rule to gateway to warn on missing headers, 3) add hard runtime cap preventing allocations beyond 50k tokens, and 4) add telemetry alert for a single client exceeding token growth thresholds.
SRE-Oncall (nora): Root cause summary: permissive runtime default for missing max_tokens + missing ingress validation => runaway decode => GPU OOMs and container restarts => request drops. Mitigations applied; service stabilized.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Severity lowered to P2. Handing off to follow-up rotation in 45m.
eng-runtime (bob): I'll open the hotpatch PR and a tracked ticket for the runtime guard (ETA PR + tests: 4h).
SRE-Oncall (nora): Good work. I'll post telemetry snapshots and a short timeline in 30m for the postmortem. :thumbsup:
Alice-CustOps: Drafting customer advisory: included actions taken and recommended client fix (set max_tokens or update SDK). Sending to CS lead now.
